# Recorded fixtures

`panel_frames.json` contains four short panel SET frames from the user's
2026-09-13 passive capture. Endpoint addresses, capture metadata, device
identifiers and unrelated traffic are excluded.

Expected observations: fan level 3, Eco Summer (1), target 21 °C,
room temperature approximately 22.62 °C. These frames are independent captured
test vectors, not generated using the implementation under test.

No command encoder or replay-to-hardware test is provided.
